command.alkahestdrops.help.reset.summary: Resets drop progress, so first_kill and first_break drops drop again and pity counters start over.
block to break, with optional states, such as minecraft:wheat[age=7].
mobs only: the mob dies on fire.
blocks only: a TNT explosion, without tool or experience.
mobs only: a mob of that type kills, so killed_by_player fails and no experience drops.
no player: generic damage for mobs, a netherite pickaxe for blocks (the console's default). No experience.
you: a copy with your name, equipment and position (the default for players). From the console, a blank player.
also drops what the report shows at your position.
drops without any chat output, for datapack functions.

forced enchantments, in the item NBT format: [{id:"minecraft:looting",lvl:3}], levels 0 to 255. They replace those levels of the item in the actor's main hand (put on the tool for blocks); level 0 removes one. Without it, every level comes from that item.
mob to kill, such as minecraft:zombie.

mobs only: what makes the drops happen, 'death' (the default), 'shear', 'hit', 'lightning' or 'periodic'. Other triggers roll only Alkahest Drops drops; shear and hit need a player, enchantments only apply on death, hit and shear, lightning and periodic have no player. Each simulated hit deals 1 damage, so damage_taken drops read per damage. With 'periodic' the number is the ticks to simulate: each drop rolls whenever its interval passes, and rates are per minute.
shows only the items matching an id, #tag or NBT; every run is still rolled in full.
/alkdrops simulate page <n> shows another page of your last report, without rolling again.
number of runs, 1 to 1000000; 1 when missing.
the actor crouches; needs a player or a killer.

issue.alkahestdrops.bad_drop_id: '%s' must use only lowercase letters, digits, '_', '-', '.' and '/'
issue.alkahestdrops.bad_removal_entry: must be an item id, '#tag', '*' or an object with 'item' and 'conditions' or with 'experience': true
issue.alkahestdrops.bonus_roll_unused: has no effect with drop_behavior type '%s'
issue.alkahestdrops.bonus_unused_by_trig: is ignored with 'on': '%s'; only death, hit and shear drops read enchantments
issue.alkahestdrops.clamped_max: is %1$s, above the limit %2$s; clamped to %2$s
issue.alkahestdrops.clamped_min: is %1$s, below the minimum %2$s; clamped to %2$s
issue.alkahestdrops.double_enchant_bonus: adds a vanilla bonus of '%s', which enchant_bonus also has, so the drop gets both bonuses
issue.alkahestdrops.drops_and_removals: a file cannot have both 'drops' and 'removals'; split it into two files
issue.alkahestdrops.duplicate_drop_id: is already used by another drop of this file
issue.alkahestdrops.duplicate_enchantmen: enchantment '%s' already has a bonus in this drop
issue.alkahestdrops.empty_enchant_bonus: must list at least one enchantment
issue.alkahestdrops.experience_with_item: cannot be used with 'item'; a drop gives either an item or experience
issue.alkahestdrops.file_not_object: file must be a JSON object
issue.alkahestdrops.first_drop_without_p: can never drop with 'on': '%s', which has no player
issue.alkahestdrops.not_a_number: must be a number, got NaN
issue.alkahestdrops.not_whole_number: must be a whole number, got %s
issue.alkahestdrops.other_first_drop_key: is a key of %s and is ignored; %s use '%s'
issue.alkahestdrops.per_player_experienc: is ignored by experience drops, which cannot be locked to a player
issue.alkahestdrops.per_player_trigger: has no effect with 'on': '%s'; only death drops roll once per attacker
issue.alkahestdrops.per_player_unused: has no effect in %s; only the breaker gets the drop
issue.alkahestdrops.pity_never_misses: has no effect: with chance 1 and a count of at least 1 the drop never misses, and pity only counts misses
issue.alkahestdrops.pity_with_first_drop: is ignored with '%s', which always drops the first time
issue.alkahestdrops.pity_without_player: is ignored with 'on': '%s', which has no player
issue.alkahestdrops.removal_experience_w: cannot be used with 'item'; an entry removes either items or experience
issue.alkahestdrops.removal_on_player: removal files cannot target players, a player's drops are their inventory
issue.alkahestdrops.set_count_replaces: replaces the rolled count, so 'count' and the enchant_bonus count bonuses are lost; set "add": true to add to the rolled count instead
issue.alkahestdrops.trigger_in_block_fil: is only valid in mob drop files; blocks only drop when they break
issue.alkahestdrops.trigger_on_drop_file: is only read in removal files; set 'on' on each drop instead
issue.alkahestdrops.unknown_function_id: '%s' is not a function of any loaded datapack; the function is ignored
issue.alkahestdrops.version_too_new: version %s is newer than the supported version %s; update Alkahest Drops
issue.alkahestdrops.zero_chance: is 0 without an enchant_bonus entry with bonus_chance, so the drop could never happen
issue.alkahestdrops.zero_count: min and max are 0 without enchant_bonus entries raising both, so the drop would always be empty
issue.alkahestdrops.zero_increment: is 0 without an enchant_bonus entry with bonus_roll.bonus_increment_per_level; clamped to 1
issue.alkahestdrops.zero_roll_chance: is 0 without an enchant_bonus entry with bonus_roll.bonus_roll_chance_per_level, so no roll could succeed
issue.alkahestdrops.zero_rolls: is 0 without an enchant_bonus entry with bonus_roll.bonus_rolls_per_level; clamped to 1
